To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the NLRP-3 inflammasomes and caspase8 are redundant for IL-1β-driven bone disease inPtpn6(cmo)mice and that the IL-β signaling is unipotent.

the NLRP inflammasome, caspase-4 and caspase -8 are required for IL-1β mediated osteomyelitis inPstpip-2(cmo) mice and that the directionality of the IL-1R/IL-1β signaling axis is important for disease induction
the NLRP-3 inflammasomes and caspase8 play a redundant role in the pathogenesis of osteomyelitis inPstpip-2 mice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanisms of IL-1 driven inflammatory bone diseases.
the role of IL-1 in the pathogenesis of bone diseases.
understanding the molecular mechanisms that promote pathogenic production of IL-1 and the directionality IL-1β to drive inflammatory bone disease.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the NLRP 3 inflammasomes and caspase8 play an important role in promoting osteomyelitis by mediating the maturation of IL-1beta in thePtpn6(cmo)mouse model of disease.
the combined actions of caspase 1 and caspases 8 and 11 in the NLRP inflammasome are important to induce osteomyelitis inPstpip(cmo)mice.
caspase 1 and caspases 8 and 11 are all important to the disease process, and the caspase 11 is important in promoting the caspase-11-mediated pyroptosis in neutrophils.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the NLRP-3 inflammasomes and caspase8 play redundant roles in IL-1β activation and that IL-1 signaling is unidirectionally from the bone to the hematopoietically-derived cells in the bone marrow.
the NLRP-3 inflammasomes and caspase8 work in concert to promote osteomyelitis inPtpn6(cmo) mice and IL-1β is the key driver of disease.
the NLRP-3 and caspase8 inflammasome complex is a critical mediator of IL-1ß-mediated chronic multifocal osteo-myelitis.
The main takeaway from our work is that
caspase 1 is not the sole inflammasome responsible for IL-1β processing.
the NLRP inflammasome is not the sole pathway that drives IL-1β secretion and caspase8 is a key player in this process.
the NLRP inflammasome is a redundant mechanism to promote pathogenic IL1β production.
